register.rationale: SSi methodology uses conversational, everyday language. Chinese learners benefit from casual English that mirrors real-world conversations.

golden_keys.usage: Core desire expression, high frequency starter pattern
Social interaction marker, high recombination value

zut_concerns.note: Using contractions (I'm, I'll, don't) consistently as this is natural spoken English
zut_concerns.resolution: Always use contractions in practice phrases for natural flow

zut_concerns.note: Chinese lacks articles - learners need explicit exposure
zut_concerns.resolution: Include varied article usage in practice phrases

lego_strategy.verb_phrases: Group verb phrases as M-type LEGOs (e.g., 'want to speak' as single LEGO)
lego_strategy.adverbs: Treat adverbs like 'now', 'today', 'tomorrow' as A-type LEGOs
lego_strategy.prepositions: Prepositional phrases like 'with you' as M-type LEGOs

notes: English word order (SVO) differs from Chinese - LEGOs will help learners internalize patterns
Focus on spoken/conversational English, not formal written style
Prioritize high-frequency vocabulary that enables maximum recombination
